title: Glowing windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff8b0' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff8b0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- windmill tower -->
  <polygon points='42,78 46,40 54,40 58,78' fill='#f4c542'/>
  <polygon points='42,78 46,40 48,40 45,78' fill='#ffe07a'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='47' y='64' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#b8862e'/>
  <!-- roof cap -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='5' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <!-- blades -->
  <g stroke='#ffcf3a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='40' x2='50' y2='14'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='40' x2='74' y2='40'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='40' x2='50' y2='66'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='40' x2='26' y2='40'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#fff2a0'>
    <rect x='45' y='12' width='10' height='14' rx='2'/>
    <rect x='72' y='35' width='14' height='10' rx='2'/>
    <rect x='45' y='54' width='10' height='14' rx='2'/>
    <rect x='14' y='35' width='14' height='10' rx='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='4' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='79' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#a8762c'/>
</svg>
